test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is, **'cooperatively'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cooperatively** means **working together or working for a common goal**.

 
 
• Example - ***Alex and Jane are working cooperatively on their class project***.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, **Individual people and the administration must work cooperatively.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anonymously** means **when the person remains unidentified**.

 
 
• Example - ***John made an anonymous phone call to tip the police about the ongoing robbery.***
 
 
 
• **Singlehandedly** means **when a person does something without taking any help**.
 
 
• Example - ***Nikki finalized the project singlehandedly***.
 
 
 
• **Forcefully** means **pressurizing.**
 
 
• Example - ***The manager forcefully makes the employees work an extra hour every day***.
